children: Rubrik, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $427.26M, an increase versus $309.86M a year earlier, while the company posted a net loss of ($61.78M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.3).
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per share, basic and diluted”.
Subscription revenue grew 39% year-over-year for the six-month period, driving total revenue growth of 38% on stronger adoption of Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC) and higher upfront RSC-Private sales.
Rubrik completed migration from legacy CDM to cloud-native RSC, with the majority of revenue now coming from RSC SaaS.
Annual recurring revenue (ARR) reached $1.66B, up 33% year-over-year, with dollar-based net retention above 119%.
Company increased R&D and sales & marketing investment, including AI and hosting spend to support the RAC launch and SaaS scaling.
Customer base expansion includes 3,084 customers with ≥$100K Subscription ARR, a 23% increase year-over-year.
